target_customer: US and international businesses with international customers, payroll, vendors or bulk payouts in many currencies
problem: Banks and FX providers charge high spreads and are slow for business cross-border payments. Levro offers a multicurrency account with low FX rates and currency risk tools.
business_model: FX spread and fees on conversions and payouts
product_category: Business multicurrency account and global payments

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires banking partners, FX liquidity, compliance and reconciliation across 30 plus currencies; a small team can build on partner APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Price based product against well-funded rivals; little structural lock-in.

market_need_then: The company claims exchange rates 40 to 90 percent lower than banks and FX services such as Wise (company description, self-reported).
